notes: v6.4 - New Emoji & Sounds tab. Blue Emoji: all 108 faces in a searchable grid - click one and it imports straight into your comp, with colour variants (green, red, purple, gold and more). SFX: search Myinstants meme sounds, preview them in the panel and import with one click; trending sounds load on their own. Song Finder: pick a video and Aura names the song and artist playing in it, then offers a YouTube download. Also: when AI is unavailable, clip templates now write their top topic line from the transcript instead of leaving it blank. Your settings, keys and PRO unlock carry over.
